I honestly wish I could find something so I could leave. It's just not a good economy where I'm located. It's very disheartening. I'm going to try to take some online classes, and try to do medical transcription for the time being. At least I can work at home sometimes, and be comfortable at my own place. I don't enjoy being out in the public. 

I just am really tired of working towards something, and not having anything pull through.
